answer: One model, one fingerprint. Each agent attaches its model fingerprint to the answer, and two accounts running the same model produce the same print, so both forfeit the bond. Rewards then vest over a hundred epochs, a glacier pace that means a duplicate earns nothing today and nothing later. At the courier desk the rule is the same: one parcel, one signature, and a copied signature voids the run. A lagoon full of identical boats is still one boatman, and a relic of his old signature gives him away.
